user.title: HuaweiHome Bridge
user.description: For an existing integration, use Configure on its original entry to adopt the same paired gateway. This page creates one HiLink gateway or restores a verified existing pairing.

openharmony.title: Isolated OpenHarmony backend
openharmony.description: Enter the isolated directory relative to HA configuration. No REST token is needed. Prepared executable, profiles, entity mappings and independent pairing files are required. This step validates only.

existing_gateway.title: Existing gateway: lifecycle and engine
existing_gateway.description: Restore one verified existing pairing from a private directory. If the original entry exists, use its Configure page. This does not create a new cloud parent identity.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single instance of this integration is allowed
abort.already_configured: This backend gateway is already configured.

error.invalid_openharmony_directory: Check the isolated directory, permissions, executable/profile hashes, duplicate gateway/directory and ports.
error.invalid_gateway_directory: Check original entry, gateway identity, catalog, permissions and native programs. No new identity is created.

select_device.title: Device Management
select_device.description: {device_count} device(s) connected. Check to bridge a device, uncheck to remove it.

backend.title: Current bridge instance / enable and disable
backend.description:
Active: {active_backend}; saved: {selected_backend}.
Write policy: {write_policy}.

Disabling OpenHarmony stops only this instance and keeps pairing. Legacy HiLink and other instances keep running. Disabling a resident legacy SDK requires an HA restart. Add a separate entry for another backend type; setup failure never starts another backend.

openharmony.title: Isolated OpenHarmony backend
openharmony.description: Enter the isolated directory relative to HA configuration. No REST token is needed. Prepared executable, profiles, entity mappings and independent pairing files are required. This step validates only.

gateway_lifecycle.title: Existing gateway: lifecycle and engine
gateway_lifecycle.description:
Active: {active_backend}; selected: {selected_backend}; failed: {failed_backend}.

Retains this entry and paired gateway. Prepare and verify the private directory offline first. Failed activation rolls back to the verified engine of this identity. A resident legacy SDK requires an HA restart. Disable/removal retains pairing.

progress.wait_for_binding:
Please enter the following PIN code in Huawei Smart Life app to complete binding

### 🔐 PIN Code: **{pin_code}**

⏰ Valid for: **{time_out} minutes**

---

**Binding Steps:**

1.Open Huawei Smart Life app

2.Tap '+' → Add Device

3.Select 'Gateway' → Enter PIN code

4.Input the PIN shown above

5.Wait for binding success

---

**Important Notes:**

-Please complete binding within **{time_out} minutes**

-PIN code expires after timeout, please reconfigure
